description: This Java class, FastMathCalc, provides extended precision implementations of various mathematical functions and precomputations such as sine, cosine, tangent tables, factorials, logarithms, exponentials, and reciprocal calculations. It is used for high-precision math computations within the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: FastMathCalc
classes.description: A utility class for high-precision mathematical function computations, including trigonometric, exponential, and logarithmic functions, as well as table generation for optimization.

methods.name: slowCos
methods.description: Computes cosine of a given value using Taylor series expansion with extended precision, optimized for small angles.

methods.name: slowSin
methods.description: Computes sine of a given value using Taylor series expansion with extended precision, optimized for small angles.

methods.name: slowLog
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of a number using a polynomial approximation, suitable for values close to 1.

methods.name: slowexp
methods.description: Calculates the exponential of a value using a series expansion in extended precision.

methods.name: expint
methods.description: Calculates the exponential of an integer power in extended precision, utilizing repeated squaring.

methods.name: printarray
methods.description: Outputs a double array or 2D array to a PrintStream in a formatted manner, including array initialization code.
